target.statement: VideoReward achieves 61.26% overall accuracy with ties on VideoGen-RewardBench.

compute.basis: Reproducing the reward-model cell requires training Qwen2-VL-2B on 182k human-annotated video-preference triplets; the paper uses 8 NVIDIA A800 80GB GPUs and does not link code or data.

blockers: No code, configs, or dataset links in the paper

Reward model training used 8 NVIDIA A800 80GB GPUs
Video alignment/Flow-DPO experiments use an internal research-purpose video generation model and 16 NVIDIA A800 80GB GPUs

title: Improving Video Generation with Human Feedback
